about:
Founded in 1963, Industrial Electronic Supply (IES) has been headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana for over six decades. The company does not disclose its ownership structure or the names of its founders.

IES operates as a distributor of industrial electronic components across five core categories: industrial controls, automation, drives, power distribution, and instrumentation. Its catalog features products from Siemens, Emerson, Turck, Banner Engineering, Rittal, Weidmüller, and Flowline, among others. Beyond product supply, IES provides technical services such as IO-Link integration support, condition monitoring for electrical control cabinets, predictive maintenance consulting, and 24/7 cloud-based monitoring. The company does not publish figures for facility size, employee count, or annual sales volume.

The company’s customer base spans aviation, logistics, maritime, brewing, power generation, oil and gas, chemical processing, water and wastewater, and general manufacturing. Concrete examples from its product announcements include cooling units for airport baggage-handling systems and port cranes, automation packages for a Texas brewery, pump control panels for irrigation and oilfield applications, and vibration sensors for predictive maintenance on production machinery.

IES highlights immediate availability of stocked valves and other components, along with specialized expertise in IO-Link communication and condition-monitoring platforms, as key differentiators. Its stated mission is to help industrial users reduce unplanned downtime and improve operational efficiency through data-driven insights and ready-to-ship inventory.
